about.title: Lakeport Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A defective product can turn an ordinary afternoon on Main Street or a quiet evening off 11th Street into a trip to the hospital. Whether it's a household appliance that overheats, a tool that malfunctions, a vehicle part that fails, or medication with an unlisted risk, the harm often traces back to a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning. California's strict liability rules mean an injured Lakeport resident generally doesn't need to prove the manufacturer was careless — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused the injury. That's meaningful in a small community like Lakeport, where access to specialized product liability counsel isn't always around the corner. We handle these cases on contingency, so pursuing a claim doesn't require money upfront. Hold onto the product and any packaging — it can matter later.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, you may not have to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that the defect existed and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which matters in a smaller market like Lakeport where a product may have passed through several hands before reaching you.

items.title: No Upfront Cost While You Recover
items.desc: We work on contingency, so there's no fee unless you recover, letting you focus on healing instead of legal bills.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Under California's strict liability rules, you generally need to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, rather than proving the manufacturer acted negligently. Our team can review your specific situation to explain how this applies.

items.question: How do you handle my claim?
items.answer: We handle product liability claims directly on contingency. We represent you, charge no upfront fees, and make legal decisions with you throughout the process.

items.question: I was hurt by a product near Main Street in Lakeport — what should I do with it?
items.answer: Keep the product, its packaging, and any receipts or instructions exactly as they were when the injury happened, since this evidence often matters for a claim. Avoid repairing or discarding it, and consider photographing it before storing it safely until you speak with us.
